process.title: How It Works
process.subtitle: Our simple and transparent treatment process

steps.title: Free Consultation
steps.body: Visit our clinic for a complete free consultation. The doctor will assess your condition and propose the optimal treatment plan with detailed pricing.

steps.title: Implant Placement
steps.body: The titanium implant is placed under local anaesthesia. The procedure takes 45-60 minutes. You will be comfortable throughout the entire process.

steps.title: Final Crown
steps.body: After the healing period (3-6 months), we place the final porcelain crown. The result looks and feels completely natural.

steps.title: Assessment
steps.body: The doctor assesses the tooth and determines if a crown is the right treatment. We take digital scans and impressions.

steps.title: Preparation
steps.body: The tooth is prepared by removing the outer layer. A temporary crown is placed during the fabrication of the permanent crown.

steps.title: Placement
steps.body: The custom porcelain crown is placed and cemented. We check the bite and aesthetics. Immediate and lasting result.

steps.title: Smile Design
steps.body: We create a digital simulation of your new smile. See the result before treatment begins. We personalise the colour, shape and size.

steps.title: Minimal Preparation
steps.body: We remove only 0.3-0.5mm from the tooth surface. This is the least invasive procedure compared to classic crowns.

steps.title: Final Application
steps.body: Precision laboratory-made veneers are bonded with special dental adhesive. Your new smile is immediate and spectacular.

treatments.title: Our Treatments
treatments.subtitle: The full range of dental services

implants.title: Dental Implants
implants.desc: A dental implant is the best permanent solution for replacing missing teeth. Made from medical-grade titanium, the implant integrates with the jawbone creating a strong base for the artificial crown.

crowns.title: Dental Crowns & Bridges
crowns.desc: A dental crown is a protective cap placed over a damaged tooth. It restores the shape, size and function of the tooth while protecting it from further damage.

veneers.title: Dental Veneers
veneers.desc: Veneers are ultra-thin porcelain layers bonded to the tooth surface. They give a dramatic smile transformation with minimal intervention.

allOn6.title: All-on-6 Implants
allOn6.desc: All-on-6 is the revolutionary solution for patients who have lost all their teeth or have severely damaged teeth. With just 6 implants we support the entire dental arch.
